Command `python3 - <<'PY'
import ctypes,ctypes.util
lib=ctypes.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library('lz4') or 'liblz4.so.1')
lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int];lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.restype=ctypes.c_int
N=88
lit=bytes([0x41])*N
for tail in [b'\x00\x00', b'\x00\x00\x00', b'\x00\x00xxxx']:
 s=bytes([0xf0, N-15])+lit+tail
 out=ctypes.create_string_buffer(b'X'*100,100); r=lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial(ctypes.create_string_buffer(s),out,len(s),N+4,100)
 print(len(s), tail.hex(), r, out.raw[N:N+8])
PY` executed with exit code 0.
